text_to_speech: (gentle music) - Come on, I wanna get a picture. (gentle music continues) I just can't believe you're graduating from Purdue tomorrow. So you're going to walk across that stage, get your diploma, and then what comes next? - I just wanna jump right in. Live somewhere amazing. - Right? - (Imani) I wanna push the limits of what's possible. See how fast I can go with just two wheels and a battery. - (Jacob) Right up to the edge. - (Imani) I'm gonna take the ideas that started here and see how far they can take me. Robotics, AI, all of it. I'm gonna know what it feels like to see the sunrise on another planet. - (Jacob) That sounds amazing. - (Imani) I'm gonna travel places most people have never been. I wanna see every species and taste every kind of food. I wanna figure out how we came to be on this tiny, beautiful, delicate rock flying 67,000 miles per hour around the sun. And I'm gonna do everything I can to secure our future. - For every dream most people have, you've got like 10. - Well, I'm gonna just keep going, again and again and again and again and again and again. (Imani cheers) - And what will you do after that? - Whatever I want.

youtube_description:
At Purdue University, there’s something more that motivates us. It’s a belief that tomorrow can be better than today — and that we have the power to change the world through small steps and giant leaps.  

From computer science to AI, aeronautical to astronautical engineering, agriculture to business, Boilermakers show up every day and push what’s possible. For ourselves. For the future.  

Purdue is just the beginning. The adventure lasts a lifetime.   
 
Take the first step at https://www.purdue.edu. 
 
#Purdue #PurdueUniversity #Boilermakers
